title: A non-technical fan rates the shows they went to
description: A non-technical fan (phone viewport) finds a past Goose show at the Charleston Pour House, taps "I Was There", rates it 5 stars with a short review, and reloads; then rates an older show from My Shows -> Past (as an imported history would leave it) and changes their mind; then a logged-out visitor browses the Goose artist page and the show page to see the ratings. Graded against the Gardner persona's nontechnical oracles (obvious state, reload persistence, duplicate prevention, jargon avoidance). Exercises data-machine-events show ratings and the extrachill-events attendee-only policy.
